sources.name: ArchDaily
sources.summary: An international team led by SANAA , in collaboration with Estudio A0 , Caá Porá Arquitectura , Jerome Haferd Studio , and Taller Capital Landscape , has been selected to design the new Museo Nacional del Ecuador (MuNA) in Quito . Titled "Living Strata," the proposal was chosen following the competition's revised final evaluation phase, which combined jury deliberation with a public voting process, and envisions the museum as a civic landscape that integrates exhibition spaces, public programs, and open green areas. The announcement concludes the international competition launched to design Ecuador 's future national museum .
sources.title: SANAA-Led Team Reveals Selected Design for Ecuador's New National Museum in Quito

sources.name: Dezeen
sources.summary: A curved brick structure by architecture studio SANAA has been selected as the new design for the National Museum of Ecuador in Quito, following reports that locals had criticised the original winning design.
